name: Fix-Printing
description: User can't print -- try the eight most common fixes in order, stop on success.

steps.name: clear-spool-files
steps.script: Stop-Service Spooler -Force; Get-ChildItem 'C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force; Start-Service Spooler

steps.name: reinstall-default-printer-port
steps.script: $dp = (Get-CimInstance Win32_Printer | Where-Object Default).Name; if ($dp) { $port = (Get-Printer $dp).PortName; Remove-PrinterPort -Name $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Add-PrinterPort -Name $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
